remarks: Welcome to 70 Rowayton Woods Drive, Norwalk, CT - an exceptional, turn-key residence in the sought-after Rowayton Woods community. This updated unit boasts a 2022 renovation featuring a beautifully designed kitchen, a sleek new bath, elegant crown molding, stylish new interior doors with updated hardware, and rich hardwood floors throughout. Enjoy breathtaking pond views that bring a sense of tranquility and natural beauty to your daily life. Rowayton Woods offers exceptional amenities, including a sparkling pool, a tennis court, and a footbridge providing direct access to the Rowayton Train Station for seamless commuting. Ideally located, this home is close to the charming village of Rowayton, Metro North Railroad, I-95, and NYC - and just a short distance from the vibrant SONO Mall, brimming with shopping, dining, and entertainment options. Combining modern updates, beautiful surroundings, and unmatched convenience, this residence is the perfect place to call home.
